job.title: Software Engineer I, Backend (Continuous Delivery)
job.pay_full: $130,000 – $180,000 a year base pay in CA, WA, NY, NJ and CT; $115,000 – $165,000 a year in all other US states

details.about: Affirm offers people a clear, predictable way to pay over time with no hidden fees. This role sits in the Continuous Delivery team within Developer Productivity, the group that owns much of the path from a developer's laptop to production: developer environments, CI/CD pipelines, test automation, dependency management and release engineering. The team builds the automation, standard patterns, predictable rollouts and recovery mechanisms that let engineering teams release independently, safely and quickly.
duties: Work on tasks that contribute to the team's projects and goals, with the support of your team
Collaborate with your team and stakeholders, keeping them informed about risks and trade-offs in your work
Balance speed and quality to hit business goals while protecting systems from downtime
Contribute to the team's community through growth and development activities
needs: Previous work or internship experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale
Familiarity with distributed-systems building blocks and technologies such as AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes
Turning a simple problem into a solution across multiple software components, with clear, well-tested, extensible code
Comfort navigating a large codebase, debugging others' code and giving feedback in code reviews
Ownership of your own growth, actively seeking feedback
Strong verbal and written communication skills for working with a global engineering team
A bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience
details.benefits: Base pay $130,000 – $180,000 a year in CA, WA, NY, NJ and CT, and $115,000 – $165,000 a year in all other US states; new employees typically start at the beginning of the range. Total compensation may include equity, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits including 100% subsidized medical coverage plus dental and vision for you and your dependents. Affirm also offers flexible time off, generous holiday calendars and an employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) at a discount.
notes: Remote-first: most roles can be done from almost anywhere in the US; all new hires are invited to an in-person onboarding
Base Pay Grade J, Equity Grade 5
Accommodations are available in the interview process for candidates with disabilities
